notes_for_editor: One guide page with three lines of history, credited to Ray Kresek's 2015 inventory, which I could not reach. Two searches found no second source. The 1942 entry is a camp, so the record kind (unknown) may need a human decision. Status stays unknown because the 1950 abandonment does not say whether anything stands. Access and the site today are not described by any source found. Fact check 2026-10-21: the guide lists Sleeping Deer Mountain under Lemhi County, not Adams County, so the story no longer names it.
